description: Land  Title Settlement Department - Wandurawa, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510282
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 191 and 192) in Wandurawa village.
